instructions: Review each archived current-renderer image against the matching WebGPU visual-report image, then change each comparison status to webgpu-better, equal-or-better, accepted-exception, pass, or accepted only after human/agent visual review.

menu-ready.note: WebGPU menu preserves the current shell readability while adding explicit WebGPU-ready capability status.

menu-unsupported.note: The current renderer had no unsupported-WebGPU state; WebGPU is better because it blocks launch with a clear capability failure instead of entering an unusable renderer.

battle-default.note: WebGPU renders 30k soldiers versus the archived current renderer's 21.2k, keeps terrain/water/HUD readable, and uses far-view impostors for hardware performance headroom.

battle-selection-hud-dpr2.note: WebGPU preserves DPR2 selection, order lines, minimap, unit cards, and clearer team-color blocks; terrain is warmer and less noisy than the archived current renderer.

campaign-whole-map.note: WebGPU campaign overview is visibly better: parchment/painted-chart treatment, stronger sea lanes, clearer faction washes, and large engraved labels.

campaign-label-zoom.note: Reopened after visual review: the WebGPU close zoom is not equal-or-better yet. It needs richer 3D-style city, army, terrain, and marker composition before release acceptance.

campaign-handoff-battle.note: WebGPU handoff battle preserves the campaign return surface and improves performance with the same battle UI/readability contract.
